name: Broadcast Timer
description: Full control plus live feedback and per-digit variables for a self-hosted broadcast time-of-day clock / count up-down timer server (https://github.com/kgtpuck/broadcast-timer). Actions cover the whole REST API (start/stop/reset/set/digit/direction/show/hide/name) -- no need for a separate Generic HTTP connection, though one can still be used alongside this module if preferred.
